summary: Documents can be searched, and the documents pages read better on a phone and in Cantonese.
details: The Documents page has a search box over titles and text, and each row names its room.
Nora can read a document by the short code at the end of its link, as she already could for archiving.

A document's title comes first on its page, the browser tab carries it, the delete confirmation can be used from the keyboard and says it can be undone in the chat, and a list that is loading or out of date says so.
Documents is now in the phone's bottom bar, and the document renderer's own words are in Chinese as well as English.
limitations: Search matches words as typed (no ranking, no stemming) and looks only at a document's current revision.
